style_when: the news is structural and abstract — a stack reordered, a layer added, a flow rerouted — and there is no literal object that carries it, so the idea is stated as a small physical assembly of recognisable parts rather than as bare shapes
prompt: On a garage wall above a concrete floor, a matte clay 3D assembly of two stacked modular housings: a large dark rust-finished cast-iron insurance-premium block bolted immovably to a galvanised steel backplate, its lower edge pressing down on a smaller bone-white tax-relief slider bracket that can shift sideways along a steel rail; a short steel lever at right disengages the lower bracket while the upper block stays fixed. Light from left, graphite, bone white, rust. Extreme asymmetric off-centre composition. Weathered concrete below, no text, no people.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random lettering, watermarks, numerals
rationale: Clay render lets the desk state the structural mismatch as a small physical assembly on a real home surface: one element fixed and weighty, the other shiftable but smaller, avoiding stock office or datacenter cliches.
subject: a fixed cast-iron insurance-premium housing pressing down on a sliding bone-white property-tax relief bracket mounted on a garage wall
core_thesis: Home insurance premiums now exceed property tax bills by 14% in most counties, but ballot relief moves only the tax levy while the risk-driven premium stays fixed.
core_conflict: movable property-tax relief versus fixed risk-priced insurance premium
composition: extreme asymmetric off-centre composition with generous breathing room
alt_text: Insurance Tops Property Tax 14%. Fixed cast-iron insurance housing pressing on a sliding bone-white tax-relief bracket on a garage wall.
caption: Insurance Tops Property Tax 14%: Voters can cut the property tax, not the insurance premium.
title: Insurance Tops Property Tax 14%

review.depicts: A rusty cast-iron box housing with a short metal lever on its right side, bolted to a galvanised steel plate on a stained concrete wall, resting on a bone-white bracket that slides along two metal rails projecting from beneath it, with a bare concrete floor below.
review.reason: The frame shows exactly the ordered mechanism — a heavy ferrous housing bearing down on a sliding pale bracket — which reads as the insurance premium pressing on the property-tax relief lever, though the hardware is generic enough that it needs the headline to be pinned to insurance and taxes, and it carries none of the article's figures.
